versions.content: If  UdpNmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE  a NM-PDU is received  PNs are requested within this message (bits are set to 1)  And the requested PNs are set to 1 within the [configured PN filter mask] then UdpNm shall store the request information (value 1) for these PNs
